data.point_in_time: signal uses facts through close D; simulated allocation starts at open of next trading day

hypotheses.leadership_continuation: ETF simultaneously in top-3 cross-sectional 5d and 20d momentum with both positive has positive forward excess return versus same-day investable-universe median.
hypotheses.active_migration_spread: Moving the next unit of capital from simultaneous bottom-3 5d/20d momentum laggards to simultaneous top-3 leaders produces positive forward spread after conservative ETF trading-cost scenarios.
hypotheses.right_tail_holding: A leader making a 20-trading-day closing high retains positive forward excess return, so new highs alone should not justify profit-taking.
